name: Nyom District Hospital
description: The main public hospital serving Nyom, open around the clock. Specializes in emergency care, maternity and general surgery, with an on-site pharmacy and lab so most urgent needs are handled in one visit.

reviews.name: Marie-Claire Ngo Bella
reviews.comment: Ma delivery went smoothly here, the maternity staff were very attentive even at 2am.

reviews.name: Bertrand Nnomo
reviews.comment: Emergency room can get crowded on weekends but they always find a way to attend to you.

name: Pharmacie Centrale Nyom
description: Sits right on Nyom Market, and runs as the neighborhood's rotating 24h "pharmacie de garde" - the one to know about for a medication emergency after normal hours.

reviews.name: Serge Mballa
reviews.comment: Saved me at midnight when my daughter had a fever, they were open and had everything.

reviews.name: Aurélie Nkeng
reviews.comment: Good stock of medication, a bit pricier than pharmacies further out but always available.

name: Clinique Espoir Nyom
description: A general clinic near the bus station specializing in pediatrics and dental care, with its own small laboratory so routine tests don't need a separate trip across town.

reviews.name: Christian Ndjock Essomba
reviews.comment: The dentist here is gentle and explains everything before treatment.

reviews.name: Larissa Abanda
reviews.comment: Took my son for a check-up, pediatric staff were patient with him.

name: Centre de Santé Nyom II
description: A government-run neighborhood health center in Nyom II handling routine consultations and the standard vaccination schedule during weekday office hours.

reviews.name: Arnaud Tchoumi
reviews.comment: Affordable consultation fees, staff are professional even when it's busy.

reviews.name: Rosine Zambo
reviews.comment: Waiting time can be long in the mornings, come early.

name: Marché de Nyom
description: The main market of Nyom I, busiest at sunrise when produce trucks arrive. Best known for fresh vegetables, fish and everyday household goods at neighborhood prices.

reviews.name: Blessing Eyenga
reviews.comment: Freshest tomatoes and okra in Nyom, I go every Saturday morning.

reviews.name: Paul Onana
reviews.comment: Prices are fair if you arrive early before it gets crowded.

name: Marché de Nyom II
description: The smaller sister market up in Nyom II, known more for clothing and household goods stalls than produce, serving the residents around Nyom II Road directly.

reviews.name: Carine Mbarga
reviews.comment: Good place for second-hand clothes at reasonable prices.

reviews.name: Franck Belinga
reviews.comment: Smaller than the main market but you can find most basics here.

name: Commissariat Central N°1 de Yaoundé (Secteur Nyom)
description: The police station covering the Nyom sector, staffed 24 hours for emergency response and incident reporting.

reviews.name: Hervé Ekotto
reviews.comment: Reported a theft here, the officers were responsive and followed up.

reviews.name: Sandrine Owona
reviews.comment: Paperwork takes time but they take reports seriously.

name: Brigade de Gendarmerie de Nyom II
description: The gendarmerie brigade covering Nyom II, running regular patrols through the neighborhood and available around the clock.

reviews.name: Yannick Bikoro
reviews.comment: Patrol presence has improved in the area recently.

reviews.name: Nadège Essiane
reviews.comment: Straightforward process to file a report.

name: Paroisse Saint-Pierre de Nyom II
description: The Catholic parish of Nyom II, holding daily mass and confession, and known locally for its community outreach programs.

reviews.name: Patrice Meka
reviews.comment: Warm community, the Sunday choir is beautiful.

reviews.name: Cynthia Manga
reviews.comment: The outreach program helped my family, very grateful.

name: Église Presbytérienne Camerounaise de Nyom
description: The Presbyterian church on Nyom Main Road, running weekly Bible study groups alongside Sunday worship and community outreach.

reviews.name: Divine Ateba
reviews.comment: Bible study group here is welcoming to newcomers.

reviews.name: Jean-Paul Fotso
reviews.comment: Good sermons, the congregation is friendly.

name: Melrose Place Hôtel
address: Rue 5.501, Nyom I (off Nyom Main Road)
description: A real, locally-run hotel a few minutes' walk from Nyom Main Road - reception staffed around the clock, with an in-house restaurant for guests who don't want to go looking for dinner after dark.

reviews.name: Ismaël Ngo Bella
reviews.comment: Quiet, clean rooms and the front desk is helpful with directions around Nyom.

reviews.name: Odile Tsafack
reviews.comment: Good value for the area, close enough to walk to the market.

name: Hôtel Tehasselois
description: Sits right on the N1 at the Émana/Nyom border, about a kilometer from Nyom Main Road - a practical option if you need a conference room as well as a bed.

reviews.name: Guy Ndifor
reviews.comment: Held a small business meeting in their conference room, worked well.

reviews.name: Estelle Njiké
reviews.comment: Basic but reliable, Wi-Fi could be faster.

name: Total Okolo
address: Nyom Main Road, near Okolo junction
description: TotalEnergies station right on Nyom Main Road, open 24 hours. Photo shown is a representative TotalEnergies station (same chain) rather than this exact pump.

reviews.name: Achille Kamdem
reviews.comment: Never run out of fuel here even when other stations in town do.

reviews.name: Florence Assam
reviews.comment: Convenient location, staff are quick.

name: Neptune Oil Nyom
address: Nyom Main Road, near the church junction
description: A Neptune Oil station a short walk from Nyom's church junction - the second real fuel option in the neighborhood alongside Total Okolo.

reviews.name: Brice Talla
reviews.comment: Good alternative when the queue at Total is long.

reviews.name: Gisèle Fouda
reviews.comment: Fair prices, no issues fueling up here.

name: Yaoundé Club
address: Nyom I, off Nyom Main Road
description: A real sports and social club right in Nyom I - the neighborhood's main recreation ground for anyone wanting exercise or a weekend social event without leaving Nyom.

reviews.name: Steve Mbezele
reviews.comment: Good grounds, I come here to play with friends most weekends.

reviews.name: Priscille Ondoa
reviews.comment: Nice atmosphere for club events, well maintained.

name: CCA (Crédit Communautaire d'Afrique) - Agence Nyom
description: A real microfinance bank branch about half a kilometer into Nyom I, confirmed via OpenStreetMap. Closes mid-afternoon on weekdays like most Cameroonian bank branches, though its ATM stays available 24h.

reviews.name: Achille Nkolo
reviews.comment: Reliable for transfers, queue moves faster than the bigger banks downtown.

reviews.name: Solange Mengue
reviews.comment: ATM here has saved me more than once on a weekend.
